#### How to add one

**A minimal input.** Follow these five steps in one Python file, `collective.py`, run from the repository root.

0. Set up: launch two CPU processes, naming the group's backend in `BACKEND` ([environment](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/layout.cpp#L190)), and make a
   small copy of the deck per process with this helper.

```bash
BACKEND=gloo torchrun --nproc-per-node=2 --master-port=29511 collective.py
```

```python
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.distributed.distributed_c10d as dist_c10d
import snapy
import yaml

def tiny_deck():
    deck = yaml.safe_load(Path("examples/straka_proc2.yaml").read_text())
    deck["geometry"]["cells"] = {"nx1": 8, "nx2": 16, "nx3": 1, "nghost": 3}
    deck.pop("outputs", None)
    path = Path(f"tiny{dist.get_rank()}.yaml")  # one file per process
    path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(deck))
    return str(path)
```

1. Create the group with `torch.distributed`, as the generated line does ([`python/exchange.py:21`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/python/exchange.py#L21)).

```python
dist.init_process_group(backend="gloo", init_method="env://")
```

2. Register it with the generated call ([`python/exchange.py:22`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/python/exchange.py#L22)). The deck lives at `examples/straka_proc2.yaml`.

```python
snapy.distributed.set_process_group(dist_c10d._get_default_group())
```

3. Build the block and call a snapy collective. `max_time_step` reduces the step across processes; the two
   processes start at different pressures, so their local steps differ.

```python
deck = tiny_deck()
block = snapy.MeshBlock(snapy.MeshBlockOptions.from_yaml(deck))
coord, eos = block.module("coord"), block.module("hydro.eos")
shape = (eos.nvar(), coord.buffer("x3v").numel(),
         coord.buffer("x2v").numel(), coord.buffer("x1v").numel())
w = torch.zeros(shape, dtype=torch.float64)
w[snapy.kIDN].fill_(1.)
w[snapy.kIPR].fill_(1.e5 * (1 + dist.get_rank()))
variables, _ = block.initialize({"hydro_w": w})
local = block.local_max_time_step(variables)
dt = block.max_time_step(variables)
```

4. Check the effect: every process gets the deck's CFL number times the smallest local step.

```python
steps = [None] * dist.get_world_size()
dist.all_gather_object(steps, local)
cfl = yaml.safe_load(Path(deck).read_text())["integration"]["cfl"]
assert steps[0] != steps[1]
assert abs(dt - cfl * min(steps)) <= 1.e-12 * dt
print(f"N6 collective: rank {dist.get_rank()} dt={dt:.6f} = cfl*min(steps)")
dist.destroy_process_group()
```

**Contract.**

- Name the backend: `BACKEND` must equal the registered group's backend name, or the block stops with "external process group backend mismatch" ([check](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L216)).
- Not with UCX: for `BACKEND=ucx`, the default of a Linux UCX build ([default](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/layout.cpp#L41)), the registered group is ignored and snapy creates its own ([routing](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L103)).
- Register first: a block's layout reads the registered group when it creates its context, and the context is cached ([creation](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L77)).
- One process uses no group: with one process the context returns before any backend ([one process](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L100)).
- CPU tensors, one per message: point-to-point sends through the group refuse CUDA tensors and lists of more than one tensor ([send](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L156)).
- Collectives go to the group and wait: `allreduce` and `reduce` call it and block ([allreduce](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L195)); the step uses MIN, then the CFL factor ([scaling](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L546)).
- Ownership: snapy never shuts the group down; destroy it after the last block ([ownership](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L221), [shutdown](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1286)).
- No card key: `distribute: backend` is accepted and ignored ([ignored](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/layout.cpp#L231)).

The generated reduction of step 3 ([`src/mesh/meshblock.cpp:535`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L535)) and Python binding ([`python/csrc/pylayout.cpp:140`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/python/csrc/pylayout.cpp#L140)) are:

```cpp
op.reduceOp = c10d::ReduceOp::MIN;
  if (_playout->has_process_group()) {
    _playout->comm->allreduce(dt_reduce, op.reduceOp);
  }
.def("set_process_group", &snap::set_process_group)
```

CI checks the contract; the two-process run is recorded in `tools/do-cards.yaml`.

**Native C++ alternative.** A backend that snapy owns is a new branch of this generated dispatch ([`src/layout/process_group.cpp:125`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274/src/layout/process_group.cpp#L125)),
next to `_init_gloo`:

```cpp
if (backend == "ucx") {
    _init_ucx();
  } else if (backend == "gloo") {
    _init_gloo();
  } else {
    throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported BACKEND=" + backend);
  }
```

An owned backend creates its group on snapy's `TCPStore`, and `finalize` shuts it down; a registered group is neither.
